title: Polish Skillet Fish Fry
description: A quick and easy fish fry recipe using a skillet. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Place the cod fillets in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the cod to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the polish rye breadcrumbs and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Serve the cod with the toasted breadcrumbs, zesty dill sauce, crisp lettuce, and lemon wedges.
Enjoy your delicious Polish Skillet Fish Fry!
